name: 전변동 노름 분석
description: Measures total variation norm to detect unnatural smoothness or excessive regularity in AI-generated images (Rudin et al., 1992).
algorithm: Total Variation Norm Analysis 분석 알고리즘
mechanism:
이 방법은 applies Total Variation (TV) analysis following Rudin, Osher & Fatemi (1992) for forensic image assessment:

1. **TotalVariation계산**: The isotropic TV of the image I is computed as TV(I) = Σ√(|∂I/∂x|² + |∂I/∂y|²), measuring the total amount of spatial variation. This L¹ norm of the gradient penalizes oscillations while preserving edges — making it sensitive to the difference between natural and synthetic image characteristics.

2. **지역TV매핑**: A spatial map of local TV values computed in sliding windows reveals the distribution of image complexity. Natural images show physically coherent TV variation — smooth regions (low TV), edges (moderate TV), and textures (high TV) arranged in semantically meaningful patterns.

3. **TVRegularity분석**: The ratio of TV to image energy (TV/‖I‖₂) provides a normalized smoothness measure. AI 생성 images often exhibit characteristic TV profiles: diffusion models tend toward overly smooth interiors with sharp boundaries, while GANs may produce micro-oscillations elevating TV in supposedly smooth regions.

4. **AnisotropicTV분해**: The directional components TV_x and TV_y are analyzed separately. Natural images show orientation-dependent TV variation correlated with scene geometry. AI 생성 images may exhibit isotropic TV even in scenes that should show strong directional bias (e.g., architectural images).

5. **ChambolleProjection분석**: Using Chambolle's (2004) dual formulation, the TV-minimizing reconstruction is computed. The difference between the original and TV-denoised image isolates the texture/noise component. Analysis of this component reveals whether the fine-scale structure follows natural sensor noise statistics or exhibits AI generation artifacts.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Rudin, L.I. et al. (1992). Nonlinear Total Variation Based Noise Removal Algorithms. Physica D.
Chambolle, A. (2004). An Algorithm for Total Variation Minimization and Applications. JMIV.
